class.name: WorldSessionDefinition
class.brief_description: Configuration for the standalone World Session API.

members.member: Path from the root of the instantiated [member player_scene] to the [Camera3D] that becomes current for the local player. Leave empty to skip the camera override.
Path from the root of the instantiated [member player_scene] to the visual subtree hidden on the local player instance. Leave empty to skip visual hiding.
Node3D scene instantiated for each occupied slot in a standalone World Session.
UDP port used to host or join the standalone session. Use a value from 1 to 65535 and configure the same port on the host and guests.
Path from the root of the instantiated [member world_scene] to the spawn container. The container's ordered [Marker3D] children define the standalone spawn slots.
The Node3D world mounted from the same local asset on each participant.
